firstPackedFailure.reason: The first46 checks passed; the new drill could not resolve core dependency alien-signals. The final adapter installs and audits the complete locked npm closure outside the checkout.

mutationMethod: Retention mutants modify isolated built distributions before native embedding. Runtime mutants rebuild a private core copy with the normal tsup/post-build pipeline but omit verify-dist only in that intentional mutant copy: verify-dist independently caught the removed guard before browser execution. The normal candidate build retains verify-dist.
